ModMetaData.name: Convergence: Formations
ModMetaData.author: Prospero1088
ModMetaData.description:
Formations (zhenfa) and fixed defenses for Convergence: Era of Cultivation.
A formation is a core burning spirit stones plus flags that enclose its area. Grand Protective Formation (a dome that absorbs enemy projectiles), Formation of Killing Swords, Formation of Binding (immobilizes the strongest enemy) and Qi Gathering Formation (more qi in the area), plus the guardian statue and the rune crossbow turret. Researched in the Dao comprehension tree. No electricity.
Requires Convergence: Era of Cultivation.
